format: Solkarte catalogue CSV (prototype columns + condition_code + reach)
notes: epoch is JD TDB; elements: heliocentric ecliptic J2000; empty cell = no value
elements are the set with the youngest epoch per object
condition_code refers to the JPL orbit solution of the SBDB round
physical properties and neo/pha come from the SBDB round below

reach columns: best outbound (LEO departure + rendezvous, dv_out_kms = total) and best return after a 180 d stay (dv_ret_kms = departure v_inf, Earth capture not included); dep_jd/ret_dep_jd JD TDB, tof in days, km/s, C3 km²/s²; empty = no transfer found (see reach_reason) or no reach round

reach_dataset.source: Columbus core (computed from stored element sets)

outbound.objective: LEO departure dv + rendezvous dv (v_inf at target)

return.objective: departure dv (v_inf) + 0.15 * max(0, v_inf at Earth - 6 km/s)

reach_method.tof_range: max(30, 0.35 t_H) .. max(tmin + 450, 2.1 t_H) days, t_H = Hohmann time
reach_method.earth_ephemeris: Standish Table 1 Earth-Moon barycentre minus 0.012150585 x geocentric Moon (prototype series); velocities by central difference (h = 0.02 d)

properties_dataset.method: JPL SBDB Query API with full-prec=true; osculating heliocentric ecliptic J2000 elements at each object's own epoch (JD TDB); values stored as delivered

1.method: JPL SBDB Query API with full-prec=true; osculating heliocentric ecliptic J2000 elements at each object's own epoch (JD TDB); values stored as delivered

5.method: JPL Horizons API, EPHEM_TYPE=ELEMENTS, CENTER=500@10, REF_PLANE=ECLIPTIC (J2000), REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, OUT_UNITS=AU-D: osculating heliocentric elements at the requested epoch (JD TDB), integrated by Horizons from the object's orbit solution
